commit.message:
feat(kernel): union/intersect and edge blends on the kernel seam, benched (M12.1 stage 2)

The dual-kernel agreement bench grows from subtract/offset to all three
booleans and constant-radius edge blends:

- Kernel trait: boolean_union, boolean_intersect, blend_edges(solid,
  picks, radius, Round | Chamfer). truck implements the booleans via
  truck-shapeops or/and; its blend_edges is Unsupported (truck has none).
- agreement.rs: four new boolean fixtures (box|box, box|cylinder boss,
  box&box, box&cylinder) through both engines vs closed forms; the heavy
  lane's fine-tessellation leg now covers them too.
- blend.rs: eleven solidcore blend fixtures vs closed forms (cube rounds
  and chamfers on 1/4/12 edges, concave L-block blends, cylinder and hole
  rims via Pappus). The circular-rim chamfer misses on the port's default
  path (upstream WR-421) and is pinned as "not yet", with a second test
  showing the opt-in fillet_chamfer_cone_on_arc fix closes it.
- Seam guards: edge picks must name exactly one edge (sampled +
  golden-section distance; vertex/seam picks refused as ambiguous); a
  conservative blend radius guard; a result law (manifold, inside the
  source box, volume moved); face-less boolean operands refused (the port
  answers box & empty with the whole box - pinned).
- corrupt_input.rs: seam rows for every new op and a separate pinned
  table of the port's own stage-2 verdicts (stage 1's table unchanged).

No production path switched; nothing outside camcraft-kernel depends on
it. Decisions in docs/decisions/27-solidcore-bench.md.

Refs #27
